summary.headline: Astrological Questions 95–115
summary.text: Catalog entries 95–115 of an astrological codex, covering fortune, Arab dominance, death, cloud-like star clusters, horoskopes, afflicted natal places, annual ingresses, rulers and adversaries, hidden matters, malefics and short life, royal departures, slave emancipation, and the Sun’s northern ascent. Authorities and sources include Stephanos, Palchus, Apomasar, and Codex Bononiensis 18.
